en: • “Gundam Exia” that appeared in the final battle from “Mobile Suit Gundam00”

• GN Drive can reproduce the expanded state just like in the movie
• Includes GN Sword Kai, GN beam saber, GN short blade, GN long blade, and GNSeal sword, which reproduce the sword with clear molding.
